method: Confronted curricular first-pass descriptions with generator question, guides and solutions; reasoned cognitive classification, not empirical learner-performance validation.

principles: N1: one direct rule/recognition, N2: model selection or meaningful conversion plus reasoning, N3: nonroutine synthesis appropriate to 2n ESO only.
A factor squared or cubed is not equivalent to a linear conversion; do not classify by numerical size alone.
U-D1, U-A2, U-VC etc. are working shared-strategy identifiers, NOT official families.
Escales:1,2,3 share proportional scale method even when direction or unit differs; avoid counting contexts as distinct families.
Unitats:13 and 17 require distractor scrutiny for implausibly obvious wrong options.
